title: Correlation-immunity bound for weight-$2^m$ functions
summary: Determine whether the source conjectured lower bound on maximum correlation immunity is valid for all admissible parameters.

formal_statement.body: Given a positive integer $l$ and $k=n-m$ in the source interval $\{2^l-l-1,\ldots,2^{l+1}-l-2\}$, let $D_{n,m}$ be the maximum correlation immunity of the source-defined $n$-variable Boolean functions of Hamming weight $2^m$. Is the conjectured lower bound $$D_{n,m}\ge \nu^{(k)}_{m-l+2}$$ (with the source's piecewise definitions for $m$ and $\nu^{(k)}$) valid for every admissible $l,m,n$? Prove or refute it and classify equality cases.

scope.domain: Correlation-immune Boolean functions used in side-channel countermeasures
assumptions: The Boolean functions are exactly those defined by the source equation (6)
$k=n-m$ lies in the stated source interval
scope.unresolved_remainder: A proof or counterexample for every admissible parameter instance and an equality classification.

progress.summary: The TIT source explicitly states this unresolved problem and fixes its mathematical scope.
